answer: Once upon a Time you created lots and lots of demons for everything. The ground loop is supposed to provide the checking that an event driven system needs to operate. Many of those things do not require timing to drive them but some do. So instead of you creating separate demons for every single thing, we hang them all off the ground loop. Directly or indirectly.
